body:
I personally think chamomile is an awesome herb that provides a way to relax at the end of the day. It definitely takes the edge off. I normally just add boiling water to 1 tbs of chamomile and let it sit for 20 minutes while stirring it occasionally. Its not a strong buzz or anything, it simply releases tension. I've noticed while smoking pot on it, the dumb stupor state is enhanced. Other than that its just an incredible soothing feeling. Its worth the $1.50 an oz.
